summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the execution of a Share Purchase Agreement with Paragon Vertical Corporation and Radius Telecoms, Inc. to acquire Paragon's 65.1% equity interest in Radius. Terms beyond the 65.1% stake were not specified in the filing. The board recommended the transaction, though no advisor was named. The agreement was signed on June 4, 2026, and disclosed to Philippine regulators. This is an acquisition of a controlling interest in a telecoms firm. Watch for regulatory approvals and any subsequent filing detailing price per share and premium.
